definition: Splitting the sequence dimension across devices (ring attention and variants) so extremely long contexts fit in memory.
details: Splitting the sequence dimension across devices (ring attention and variants) so extremely long contexts fit in memory. The enabler of million-token training.

explainer.lead: It splits the sequence dimension across devices so very long contexts fit in memory, enabling million-token training.

tiers.eli5: Like reading one very long book by tearing it into sections, with each friend holding a different section.
tiers.practitioner: Implemented via ring attention and variants that distribute sequence chunks across devices. Pitfall: memory fits but cross-device communication grows with context length.
tiers.paperLevel: Partitions the sequence dimension over devices; ring attention and variants pass information around the ring so a single long sequence is processed collectively.

explainer.example: Training on contexts of a million tokens by distributing the token sequence across GPUs.
